description: Source code for ShareViewController class handling media and text sharing extensions in an iOS app, including file handling, media processing, and communication with host app.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: View controller managing sharing extension, handling media and text input, file copying, and communication with host app.

classes.name: SharedMediaFile
classes.description: Model representing shared media items with path, thumbnail, duration, and type.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initial setup, calls cancel and runSelectPost.

methods.name: runSelectPost
methods.description: Processes input items, dispatches handling based on media type.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Loads and appends text data, saves to user defaults, and redirects.

methods.name: handleUrl
methods.description: Loads URL data, appends to sharedText, saves, and redirects.

methods.name: handleImages
methods.description: Copies image files, appends to sharedMedia, saves, and redirects.

methods.name: handleVideos
methods.description: Copies video files, creates thumbnail, appends, saves, and redirects.

methods.name: handleFiles
methods.description: Copies file URLs, appends, saves, and redirects.

methods.name: dismissWithError
methods.description: Displays error alert and completes extension request.

methods.name: redirectToHostApp
methods.description: Constructs URL and performs openURL to redirect to host app.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Determines file extension based on URL and media type.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Generates filename from URL, with UUID fallback.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies file from source to destination URL, returns success status.

methods.name: getSharedMediaFile
methods.description: Creates SharedMediaFile object for video, including thumbnail and duration.

methods.name: getThumbnailPath
methods.description: Generates thumbnail path for video URL.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Encodes array of SharedMediaFile to Data using JSONEncoder.
